videos.title: Odyssey Returns to the Cultural Spotlight
videos.description: University of Pennsylvania classics professor Emily Wilson says Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey is introducing a new generation to Homer, driving a surge in book sales, library checkouts and interest in studying the classics. Wilson says diverse audiences and fresh perspectives continue to enrich the interpretation of ancient texts, while emphasizing that every translation begins with the original Greek rather than previous English versions. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Huang Sees AI Driving Chip Boom
videos.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says artificial intelligence is transforming the semiconductor industry as computers increasingly serve AI agents and robots, driving demand for a much larger global chip supply chain and deepening the company's partnership with South Korea's SK Group. He also says China will remain a leading AI innovator despite different constraints, while arguing that open AI models are essential for innovation, security and giving businesses greater control over their own systems. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
